title: Croatian Stew with Yellow Onions and Silky Texture
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Croatia, made with tender onions and a silky twist.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the Croatian stew mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in the vegetable broth and water (if using), and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the stew has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
